findings.problem: The voice says "two terms below" here, just after beat 2 said "two surd terms", so the name is loose.
findings.fix: Say "When there are two surd terms below, we multiply the top and the bottom by the conjugate."

findings.rule: highlight only at the right moment
findings.problem: The bottom of the (√5)² − (√3)² line is lit again as the beat starts, but beat 12 already lit it, so it re-lights what is already lit.
findings.fix: Drop the opening "light {e1} d" in beat 13 and keep only the light on {f1}'s bottom on "no surd is".

findings.problem: The voice names the form A plus B times A minus B but never says what it becomes, so the student must read the note alone to see why the next line has squares.
findings.fix: End the beat with "and A plus B, times A minus B, is A squared minus B squared" while the note is written.
